fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner present. Research: internal/run/engine.go arbitrates a question only when State.Autonomous, set only by run start --autonomous; conductor runs 01M7DVV7 and 01M7E56M (ship-rhiza, every rhiza.autonomy stage auto) started without it, so the conductor's AskUserQuestion launched an advisor and blocked on the owner. Hand-queued run start and daemonStart dropping --autonomous for an owner sign-off hit the same path. A child session started with rhiza run spawn is not watched for questions by anything: its denied question in an autonomous run is never arbitrated. The planner asked which fix to build; the arbiter decided (Decision conductor-questions-to-arbiter, wording (assumed, would have escalated)): questions from the conductor step and from its spawned sessions always go to the arbiter, with no advisor or owner notice, whatever --autonomous says; State.Autonomous keeps governing only the owner's gates and sign-off; do not force --autonomous on conductor runs.
fields.title: Conductor questions stall: autonomous plan of bug 01M7M51
